new_cc: CC-12 (proposed). Third-party named account path that reaches AER/SEM/PROV, one canonical rule. (a) The source's own harness, workstation or cluster account (tracebacks, dataset locations, host homes) is source-defect S0 with security=true when the profile declares no redaction rule. (b) Developer paths inside public third-party content the agent fetched (web pages, issue trackers, vendored logs) are source-defect S2 with security=true, plus a disclosure and an owner check by digest. (c) Benchmark or model-authored paths stay CC-03 expected-known S3.
